title: Descent of a transported ring action and split retraction
statement: Let L:A -> D be a functor such that precomposition along L induces bijections on natural transformations into every pair of E-valued functors, where E is preadditive. A ring action, balanced map, and section on a pair of precomposed functors descend together, including their two split identities. More generally the same applies after mapping an action and split retraction by an additive functor and transporting across two specified comparison isomorphisms. A full essentially surjective functor L has the required bijectivity.

source.place: Categories, Tags 04VI, 04VJ and 04VK; elementary fully faithful precomposition and conjugation.

proof.text: For full essentially surjective L, conjugate components by chosen image isomorphisms. Lift arrows by fullness to prove naturality and check the inverse formulas using naturality at the image isomorphisms.
Lift each action endomorphism and both retraction maps by surjectivity of precomposition. Injectivity proves all ring laws and both split identities.

Map the original action by the additive functor and conjugate by the source comparison. Conjugate the two retraction maps by source and target comparisons. Functoriality and the isomorphism identities preserve both split identities. Apply the preceding descent, and cancel the comparison to obtain the normalization squares.

theorem exists_splitAction_of_comparison
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D]
    {E : Type uE} [Category.{vE} E] [Preadditive E]
    {X : Type*} [Category X] [Preadditive X]
    (L : A ⥤ D)
    (h : ∀ U V : D ⥤ E, Function.Bijective
      (fun τ : U ⟶ V ↦ Functor.whiskerLeft L τ))
    (G : X ⥤ (A ⥤ E)) [G.Additive] {x y : X}
    (U V : D ⥤ E) (α : G.obj x ≅ L ⋙ U) (β : G.obj y ≅ L ⋙ V)
    {R : Type r} [Ring R] (e : R) (a : R →+* End x) (b : x ⟶ y) (s : y ⟶ x)
    (hsb : s ≫ b = 𝟙 _) (hbs : b ≫ s = a e) :
    ∃ (a' : R →+* End U) (b' : U ⟶ V) (s' : V ⟶ U),
      s' ≫ b' = 𝟙 V ∧ b' ≫ s' = a' e ∧
      (∀ t, G.map (a t) ≫ α.hom = α.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft L (a' t)) ∧
      G.map b ≫ β.hom = α.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft L b'
